correctness.rationale: Odd-grid Dirichlet cardinal identities give all weights exactly. Reflection, strict csc convexity and a three-ratio monotonicity argument prove the sharp one-crossing classification on the full continuous parameter interval, including zero-weight equality cases. Monotonicity of t cot t and an implicit expansion give the all-size asymptotic. A separate cardinal Gram computation proves the noise formula. Independent high-precision Fourier solves and 411 numerical checks supplement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: A two-corrupted-timestamp support constraint is a natural localized robustness model not reducible to unrestricted multi-site jitter. The result gives a sharp all-odd-grid positivity tolerance, identifies exactly which two weights fail first, proves an increasing grid-size trend to a nontrivial constant, and quantifies observation-noise amplification. This is a complete, motivated structural classification, not a small isolated numeric increment or practical speedup claim.
